records.assetReview: Twelve symbolic 1 L cells form four groups of three, labeled successive 1 s intervals, without claiming intermittent flow. Flow bars 90 and 120 px at 30 px/(L/s) represent 3 and 4 L/s. Cumulative-volume graph origin (100,1280), time scale 60 px/s and volume scale 15 px/L: endpoints (340,1100) and (280,1100) give 12 L after 4 or 3 s. Both lines terminate at the required delivered volume. Full XML and native rendering read.
records.distractors: 36 multiplies volume by flow and has the wrong dimensions; 3 copies flow, 12 copies volume. The inverse check 3·4 = 12 reconstructs the delivered amount.
records.manualArithmetic: Delivered volume obeys V = Qt. At 12 L and 3 L/s, t = 12/3 = 4 s.
records.physicalAssumptions: Constant positive net volumetric rate measured at the receiving vessel, through an already filled line, with enough supply and receiving capacity. No leakage, evaporation or uncounted storage. Timing starts in established regime and neglects startup and shutdown. V,Q may vary across independent trials but not during one transfer; no integer count constraint exists.
